title: Macquarie Media Group - proposed acquisition of certain regional radio assets owned by Fairfax Media Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC released Statement of Issues in relation to proposed acquisition.
Closing date for submissions in response to Statement of Issues.
Draft undertakings put forward by Macquarie Media. Former proposed date of 10 October 2007 for announcement of ACCC's findings amended to 18 October 2007 to allow for market consultation.
Closing date for submissions relating to the draft 87B undertakings.
ACCC decided not to oppose the proposed transaction subject to the acceptance of court-enforceable undertakings.
